subject.title: feat: add OpenClaw registry export bridge

question: Should this PR publish `buildOpenClawRegistryExport` as a stable root `clawhub-schema` registry bridge API now, and should it target hosted catalog feeds, account/publisher feeds, or both?
rationale: The implementation is bounded, but it creates a public package contract for OpenClaw review/export semantics while adjacent feed API work is still unsettled.

options.title: Confirm and land the bridge contract
options.body: Approve the root schema export and clarify which feed surfaces are in scope before resolving conflicts and merging.

options.title: Keep the helper internal for now
options.body: Avoid the root export until the feed and OpenClaw review contract is less fluid.

options.title: Pause behind account feeds
options.body: Wait for https://github.com/openclaw/clawhub/pull/2948 to settle before deciding the bridge shape.

recommendation.title: Confirm and land the bridge contract
recommendation.body: Approve the root schema export and clarify which feed surfaces are in scope before resolving conflicts and merging.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen has the strongest current-history connection to the catalog feed schema and root package export surface this PR extends.
